Which statement about a solid, a liquid or a gas is correct?
A
A solid has a fixed shape and can be compressed.
B
A liquid takes the shape of the container it is in and can be compressed.
C
A solid has no fixed shape and cannot be compressed.
D
A gas takes the shape of the container it is in and can be compressed.

options.label: A
options.text: A solid has a fixed shape and can be compressed.

options.label: B
options.text: A liquid takes the shape of the container it is in and can be compressed.

options.label: C
options.text: A solid has no fixed shape and cannot be compressed.

options.label: D
options.text: A gas takes the shape of the container it is in and can be compressed.
